meta.coordinate_model: Poincare ball + Lorentz hyperboloid, curvature=1, dims=16
meta.angle_model: theta/phi spherical angles over tfidf_truncated_svd direction; structured SOP text fields
meta.flat_twin_model: same coordinates as poincare; Flat-Twin swaps only the distance function at runtime
meta.euclidean_model: independent flat direction coordinates with L2-normalized direction; no support-radius scaling
meta.note: Bootstrap artifact from SkillGraph-C compact cards; metric is p_hat/n_use proxy, not transition-level metric_delta.

nodes.title: Clean merged or generated code before execution
nodes.action: Before execution, remove merge markers, stray prose, duplicated definitions, Markdown/HTML fragments, and other non-Python artifacts.
nodes.principle: Before execution, remove merge markers, stray prose, duplicated definitions, Markdown/HTML fragments, and other non-Python artifacts.

nodes.condition: After patching, merging, copy-pasting, or generating code.

nodes.title: Run a script-order sanity check before execution
nodes.action: Before running a long script, scan it top-to-bottom and ensure every variable, function, class, helper, fold index, and loader is defined before first use.
nodes.principle: Before running a long script, scan it top-to-bottom and ensure every variable, function, class, helper, fold index, and loader is defined before first use.

nodes.condition: Long scripts, merged snippets, multi-stage pipelines, or refactors.

nodes.title: Ensure feature dimension matches model input dimension
nodes.action: When combining engineered features with a neural network, verify that the number of input features matches the model's expected input dimension (e.g., set num_features to the actual feature count from the pipeline).
nodes.principle: When combining engineered features with a neural network, verify that the number of input features matches the model's expected input dimension (e.g., set num_features to the actual feature count from the pipeline).

nodes.condition: When building hybrid models that concatenate handcrafted features with learned representations.

nodes.title: Fit scaler/vectorizer on training fold only to prevent data leakage
nodes.action: When using per-fold feature scaling or vectorization, fit the scaler/vectorizer on the training fold only, then transform both training and validation folds. Do not use a pre-fitted scaler from outside the fold.
nodes.principle: When using per-fold feature scaling or vectorization, fit the scaler/vectorizer on the training fold only, then transform both training and validation folds. Do not use a pre-fitted scaler from outside the fold.

nodes.condition: When performing cross-validation with feature scaling or vectorization.

nodes.title: Use EfficientNet-B0 with end-to-end fine-tuning and CutMix augmentation for cactus classification
nodes.action: Use a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 backbone from timm, fine-tune end-to-end with BCEWithLogitsLoss, AdamW optimizer (backbone lr=5e-5, head lr=1e-3), warmup cosine annealing scheduler, CutMix augmentation (50% probability per batch), gradient clipping, and early stopping based on validation AUC.
nodes.principle: Use a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 backbone from timm, fine-tune end-to-end with BCEWithLogitsLoss, AdamW optimizer (backbone lr=5e-5, head lr=1e-3), warmup cosine annealing scheduler, CutMix augmentation (50% probability per batch), gradient clipping, and early stopping based on validation AUC.
applies_when: When performing binary image classification on the aerial cactus identification dataset with limited data (~14K images) and near-perfect validation AUC is desired.
nodes.condition: When performing binary image classification on the aerial cactus identification dataset with limited data (~14K images) and near-perfect validation AUC is desired.

nodes.title: Use two-stage feature extraction with frozen backbone and MLP classifier for quick baseline
nodes.action: Use a frozen pretrained backbone (e.g., EfficientNet-B0, ResNet50) to extract features, cache them to disk, then train a small MLP classifier (LayerNorm + 2-3 linear layers with GELU and dropout) on the extracted features using BCEWithLogitsLoss, AdamW optimizer, and ReduceLROnPlateau scheduler.
nodes.principle: Use a frozen pretrained backbone (e.g., EfficientNet-B0, ResNet50) to extract features, cache them to disk, then train a small MLP classifier (LayerNorm + 2-3 linear layers with GELU and dropout) on the extracted features using BCEWithLogitsLoss, AdamW optimizer, and ReduceLROnPlateau scheduler.
applies_when: When needing a quick baseline or when computational resources are limited (e.g., GPU memory constraints) for aerial cactus identification.
nodes.condition: When needing a quick baseline or when computational resources are limited (e.g., GPU memory constraints) for aerial cactus identification.

nodes.title: Use handcrafted features combined with CNN features for robust classification
nodes.action: Extract handcrafted features (color histograms, GLCM texture, LBP, edge features, statistical features, HOG, pooled grayscale) and combine with CNN features from a pretrained EfficientNet-V2-S. Standardize features with StandardScaler and train an MLP classifier with BatchNorm, ReLU, and dropout.
nodes.principle: Extract handcrafted features (color histograms, GLCM texture, LBP, edge features, statistical features, HOG, pooled grayscale) and combine with CNN features from a pretrained EfficientNet-V2-S. Standardize features with StandardScaler and train an MLP classifier with BatchNorm, ReLU, and dropout.
applies_when: When deep learning features alone may not capture all relevant patterns, or as a fallback when GPU memory is limited for aerial cactus identification.
nodes.condition: When deep learning features alone may not capture all relevant patterns, or as a fallback when GPU memory is limited for aerial cactus identification.

nodes.title: Use correct attribute name for SigLIP model config hidden_size
nodes.action: When accessing the hidden size of a SigLIP model from HuggingFace, use 'hidden_size' (with the typo) instead of 'hidden_size' as the config attribute. Alternatively, access via 'vision_config.hidden_size'.
nodes.principle: When accessing the hidden size of a SigLIP model from HuggingFace, use 'hidden_size' (with the typo) instead of 'hidden_size' as the config attribute. Alternatively, access via 'vision_config.hidden_size'.

nodes.condition: When working with SigLIP models (e.g., google/siglip2-so400m-patch16-256) from HuggingFace transformers and needing to get the hidden dimension for classifier head construction.

nodes.title: Use correct DINOv2 input size (518x518) when using vit_large_patch14_dinov2
nodes.action: When using DINOv2 ViT-Large model from timm (vit_large_patch14_dinov2.lvd142m), resize input images to 518x518 as required by the model. Using smaller sizes (e.g., 224x224) will cause assertion errors.
nodes.principle: When using DINOv2 ViT-Large model from timm (vit_large_patch14_dinov2.lvd142m), resize input images to 518x518 as required by the model. Using smaller sizes (e.g., 224x224) will cause assertion errors.

nodes.title: Use patch-based extraction with overlapping patches and weighted averaging reconstruction
nodes.action: Extract overlapping patches (e.g., 64x64 with stride 32) from full-resolution images, train on patches, and reconstruct full images by weighted averaging of overlapping predictions to preserve high-frequency details and avoid resolution loss.
nodes.principle: Extract overlapping patches (e.g., 64x64 with stride 32) from full-resolution images, train on patches, and reconstruct full images by weighted averaging of overlapping predictions to preserve high-frequency details and avoid resolution loss.
applies_when: When working with image denoising tasks where full-image resizing destroys fine details and training data is limited.
nodes.condition: When working with image denoising tasks where full-image resizing destroys fine details and training data is limited.

nodes.title: Use attention gates in U-Net skip connections for denoising
nodes.action: Add attention gates (e.g., additive attention) to the skip connections of a U-Net to suppress irrelevant features and enhance important spatial regions, improving denoising quality.
nodes.principle: Add attention gates (e.g., additive attention) to the skip connections of a U-Net to suppress irrelevant features and enhance important spatial regions, improving denoising quality.

nodes.condition: When building a U-Net for image denoising and standard skip connections propagate noise or irrelevant features.

nodes.title: Use combined loss with RMSE, SSIM, and edge-aware (Sobel) loss for denoising
nodes.action: Combine RMSE (or MSE), SSIM, and an edge-aware loss (e.g., L1 on Sobel gradients) to balance pixel accuracy, perceptual quality, and edge preservation.
nodes.principle: Combine RMSE (or MSE), SSIM, and an edge-aware loss (e.g., L1 on Sobel gradients) to balance pixel accuracy, perceptual quality, and edge preservation.

nodes.condition: When training a denoising model and standard L1/L2 loss produces blurry results or loses edge sharpness.

nodes.title: Set DataLoader num_workers=0 to avoid shared memory issues in Kaggle environments
nodes.action: Set num_workers=0 in DataLoader to avoid shared memory bus errors and worker crashes in restricted environments like Kaggle notebooks.
nodes.principle: Set num_workers=0 in DataLoader to avoid shared memory bus errors and worker crashes in restricted environments like Kaggle notebooks.

nodes.condition: When running in a Kaggle or similar environment with limited shared memory and encountering DataLoader worker crashes.

nodes.title: Ensure SSIM loss tensor dtype matches model input dtype under mixed precision
nodes.action: Create the Gaussian window for SSIM loss with the same dtype as the input tensors (e.g., using .type_as()) to avoid dtype mismatch when using autocast (AMP).
nodes.principle: Create the Gaussian window for SSIM loss with the same dtype as the input tensors (e.g., using .type_as()) to avoid dtype mismatch when using autocast (AMP).

nodes.condition: When using SSIM loss inside an autocast context with mixed precision training.

nodes.title: Use CalibratedClassifierCV with estimator parameter instead of deprecated base_estimator
nodes.action: When using CalibratedClassifierCV from scikit-learn, pass the base model via the 'estimator' parameter, not the deprecated 'base_estimator' parameter.
nodes.principle: When using CalibratedClassifierCV from scikit-learn, pass the base model via the 'estimator' parameter, not the deprecated 'base_estimator' parameter.

nodes.condition: When using CalibratedClassifierCV in scikit-learn versions >=0.24.

nodes.title: Resize images to dimensions that are multiples of the patch size for ViT models
nodes.action: When using Vision Transformers (e.g., DINOv2 with patch size 14), resize images to dimensions that are multiples of the patch size (e.g., 224, 252) to avoid assertion errors in patch embedding.
nodes.principle: When using Vision Transformers (e.g., DINOv2 with patch size 14), resize images to dimensions that are multiples of the patch size (e.g., 224, 252) to avoid assertion errors in patch embedding.

nodes.condition: When using ViT models with patch-based embeddings.

nodes.title: Use consistent variable names to avoid NameError from undefined variables
nodes.action: After feature engineering, ensure the variable names used for training data (e.g., X_train, y_train) match those used in subsequent steps. Avoid referencing variables like X_train_fold that were never defined.
nodes.principle: After feature engineering, ensure the variable names used for training data (e.g., X_train, y_train) match those used in subsequent steps. Avoid referencing variables like X_train_fold that were never defined.

nodes.condition: When building data processing pipelines with multiple steps.

nodes.title: Avoid data leakage by fitting PCA and scalers on training fold only
nodes.action: When performing dimensionality reduction (PCA) or scaling, fit the transformation on the training fold only, then transform validation and test sets using the fitted object. Do not fit separately on each split.
nodes.principle: When performing dimensionality reduction (PCA) or scaling, fit the transformation on the training fold only, then transform validation and test sets using the fitted object. Do not fit separately on each split.

nodes.condition: When applying PCA or StandardScaler in cross-validation or train/validation splits.

nodes.title: Use early stopping based on validation log loss to prevent overfitting
nodes.action: Monitor validation log loss each epoch and stop training if it does not improve for a patience number of epochs (e.g., 30), restoring the best model weights.
nodes.principle: Monitor validation log loss each epoch and stop training if it does not improve for a patience number of epochs (e.g., 30), restoring the best model weights.
applies_when: When training neural networks on small datasets to avoid overfitting and save time.
nodes.condition: When training neural networks on small datasets to avoid overfitting and save time.

nodes.title: Use AdamW optimizer with weight decay for regularization
nodes.action: Use torch.optim.AdamW with weight_decay=1e-4 to apply decoupled weight decay, improving generalization.
nodes.principle: Use torch.optim.AdamW with weight_decay=1e-4 to apply decoupled weight decay, improving generalization.
applies_when: When training neural networks, especially transformers or MLPs, to regularize weights.
nodes.condition: When training neural networks, especially transformers or MLPs, to regularize weights.

nodes.title: Use gradient clipping to stabilize training and avoid NaN losses
nodes.action: Apply torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0) after loss.backward() to prevent gradient explosion.
nodes.principle: Apply torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0) after loss.backward() to prevent gradient explosion.
applies_when: When training deep networks, especially with mixup or complex architectures, to avoid numerical instability.
nodes.condition: When training deep networks, especially with mixup or complex architectures, to avoid numerical instability.

nodes.title: Avoid using statistical features computed per-sample across the whole dataset before splitting
nodes.action: Do not compute per-sample statistics (e.g., mean, std, skewness) on the full dataset before train/validation split, as they leak information from other samples. Compute them within each fold's training data only.
nodes.principle: Do not compute per-sample statistics (e.g., mean, std, skewness) on the full dataset before train/validation split, as they leak information from other samples. Compute them within each fold's training data only.
applies_when: When engineering features that involve per-sample aggregations across the dataset.
nodes.condition: When engineering features that involve per-sample aggregations across the dataset.

nodes.title: Use correct attribute name for HuggingFace model backbone layers
nodes.action: Access the backbone of a HuggingFace model via the correct attribute (e.g., model.backbone for ModernBERT, model.deberta for DeBERTa) instead of assuming a generic name.
nodes.principle: Access the backbone of a HuggingFace model via the correct attribute (e.g., model.backbone for ModernBERT, model.deberta for DeBERTa) instead of assuming a generic name.

nodes.condition: When building custom models that wrap HuggingFace transformers and need to access the underlying encoder.

nodes.title: Use correct file path for training data and avoid hardcoded local paths
nodes.action: Use relative paths or environment variables to locate data files (e.g., './input/train.csv') instead of hardcoded absolute paths that may not exist in the execution environment.
nodes.principle: Use relative paths or environment variables to locate data files (e.g., './input/train.csv') instead of hardcoded absolute paths that may not exist in the execution environment.

nodes.condition: When writing code that will run in different environments (e.g., local vs Kaggle).

nodes.title: Handle missing values per feature group with median imputation to avoid data leakage
nodes.action: Impute missing values separately for each feature group (margin, shape, texture) using SimpleImputer(strategy='median') fitted on the training fold only, to prevent leakage from validation data.
nodes.principle: Impute missing values separately for each feature group (margin, shape, texture) using SimpleImputer(strategy='median') fitted on the training fold only, to prevent leakage from validation data.

nodes.condition: When preprocessing tabular data with missing values and natural feature groupings.

nodes.title: Use correct file path for training data
nodes.action: Read training data from './input/labels.csv' instead of './input/train.csv' when the dataset uses a different filename.
nodes.principle: Read training data from './input/labels.csv' instead of './input/train.csv' when the dataset uses a different filename.

nodes.title: Avoid scaling categorical features with StandardScaler
nodes.action: Separate categorical features from numerical features before scaling; apply StandardScaler only to numerical columns to prevent negative values in categorical features that LightGBM cannot handle.
nodes.principle: Separate categorical features from numerical features before scaling; apply StandardScaler only to numerical columns to prevent negative values in categorical features that LightGBM cannot handle.

nodes.condition: When preprocessing data for tree-based models that treat categorical features as integers.

nodes.title: Exclude non-numeric columns before filling NaNs with median
nodes.action: When filling missing values with the median, select only numeric columns to avoid TypeError on datetime or object columns.
nodes.principle: When filling missing values with the median, select only numeric columns to avoid TypeError on datetime or object columns.

nodes.condition: When using fillna with median on a DataFrame that contains non-numeric columns.

nodes.title: Compute group statistics on training fold only to prevent data leakage
nodes.action: Compute location-based group statistics (mean, std, count) only on the training portion after splitting, not on the full dataset before split, to avoid leaking validation information.
nodes.principle: Compute location-based group statistics (mean, std, count) only on the training portion after splitting, not on the full dataset before split, to avoid leaking validation information.

nodes.condition: When engineering features that involve aggregating target statistics by location or group.

nodes.title: Use ensemble of raw-fare and log-fare LightGBM models
nodes.action: Train two LightGBM models: one on raw fare and one on log-transformed fare, then ensemble their predictions (e.g., average) to handle the right-skewed fare distribution.
nodes.principle: Train two LightGBM models: one on raw fare and one on log-transformed fare, then ensemble their predictions (e.g., average) to handle the right-skewed fare distribution.

nodes.condition: When the target variable has a long tail and log transformation helps normalize the distribution.

nodes.title: Freeze backbone and use XGBoost on embeddings to avoid overfitting
nodes.action: Extract frozen transformer embeddings (e.g., [CLS] token) and train an XGBoost classifier with multi:softprob objective, early stopping, and cross-validation. This avoids fine-tuning instability and overfitting.
nodes.principle: Extract frozen transformer embeddings (e.g., [CLS] token) and train an XGBoost classifier with multi:softprob objective, early stopping, and cross-validation. This avoids fine-tuning instability and overfitting.

nodes.condition: When fine-tuning a large transformer leads to severe overfitting or training instability.

nodes.title: Use ModernBERT-large with proper training regularization
nodes.action: Fine-tune ModernBERT-large with AdamW (lr=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01), cosine annealing with warm restarts, gradient accumulation (2 steps), gradient clipping (max_norm=1.0), mixed precision, and early stopping (patience=3). Use stratified 85/15 split.
nodes.principle: Fine-tune ModernBERT-large with AdamW (lr=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01), cosine annealing with warm restarts, gradient accumulation (2 steps), gradient clipping (max_norm=1.0), mixed precision, and early stopping (patience=3). Use stratified 85/15 split.

nodes.condition: When using ModernBERT-large for text classification and needing to mitigate overfitting.

nodes.title: Force SentenceTransformer to use CPU to avoid GPU OOM
nodes.action: Initialize SentenceTransformer with device='cpu' to avoid GPU memory contention when other processes occupy most VRAM.
nodes.principle: Initialize SentenceTransformer with device='cpu' to avoid GPU memory contention when other processes occupy most VRAM.

nodes.condition: When GPU memory is insufficient for loading a SentenceTransformer model due to other processes.

nodes.title: Set DataLoader num_workers=0 to avoid shared memory issues
nodes.action: Set num_workers=0 in DataLoader (and optionally pin_memory=False) to prevent 'No space left on device' or CUDA bus errors caused by limited shared memory (/dev/shm) in containerized environments.
nodes.principle: Set num_workers=0 in DataLoader (and optionally pin_memory=False) to prevent 'No space left on device' or CUDA bus errors caused by limited shared memory (/dev/shm) in containerized environments.

nodes.condition: When encountering 'Bus error' or 'No space left on device' during DataLoader worker initialization, or when using multiprocessing with limited shared memory.

nodes.title: Disable gradient checkpointing when using gradient accumulation
nodes.action: Disable gradient_checkpointing_enable() when using gradient accumulation with AMP, as it causes 'Trying to backward through the graph a second time' errors. Instead, reduce batch size to manage memory.
nodes.principle: Disable gradient_checkpointing_enable() when using gradient accumulation with AMP, as it causes 'Trying to backward through the graph a second time' errors. Instead, reduce batch size to manage memory.

nodes.condition: When training a transformer model with gradient accumulation and mixed precision, and encountering backward pass errors.

nodes.action: Fine-tune DeBERTa-v3-large with AdamW, linear warmup, mixed precision, gradient clipping, label smoothing, and early stopping. Combine its embeddings with engineered features (stylometric, readability, POS, n-grams) and train XGBoost and Logistic Regression, then optimize ensemble weights via validation log loss.
nodes.principle: Fine-tune DeBERTa-v3-large with AdamW, linear warmup, mixed precision, gradient clipping, label smoothing, and early stopping. Combine its embeddings with engineered features (stylometric, readability, POS, n-grams) and train XGBoost and Logistic Regression, then optimize ensemble weights via validation log loss.

nodes.condition: When aiming for top performance on text classification tasks with sufficient GPU memory and training time.

nodes.action: Use DeBERTa-v3-base with a classification head, disable contrastive loss to avoid NaN, use AdamW with linear warmup, mixed precision, gradient accumulation, and early stopping. Ensure checkpoint loading uses the exact saved filename.
nodes.principle: Use DeBERTa-v3-base with a classification head, disable contrastive loss to avoid NaN, use AdamW with linear warmup, mixed precision, gradient accumulation, and early stopping. Ensure checkpoint loading uses the exact saved filename.

nodes.condition: When using DeBERTa-v3-base with multi-task learning; disable contrastive loss if numerical instability occurs.

nodes.title: Use ModernBERT-large with proper dropout configuration via config object
nodes.action: Load ModernBertForSequenceClassification without dropout kwargs, then set dropout via model.config.hidden_dropout_prob and model.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob after loading.
nodes.principle: Load ModernBertForSequenceClassification without dropout kwargs, then set dropout via model.config.hidden_dropout_prob and model.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob after loading.

nodes.condition: When using ModernBERT from HuggingFace and needing to adjust dropout probabilities.

nodes.principle: Use StratifiedKFold from sklearn to split the training data into folds that preserve the class distribution; use one fold for validation and the rest for training.

nodes.condition: When dealing with imbalanced classification tasks to ensure representative validation metrics.

nodes.action: Monitor validation loss and stop training if no improvement for a set number of epochs (e.g., patience=3); save the best model checkpoint.
nodes.principle: Monitor validation loss and stop training if no improvement for a set number of epochs (e.g., patience=3); save the best model checkpoint.

nodes.condition: When training deep learning models to prevent overfitting and save time.

nodes.title: Use text augmentation (word swaps, punctuation insertion, vowel noise, synonym replacement) to reduce overfitting
nodes.action: Apply balanced text augmentations to training samples: random word swaps within a window, random punctuation insertion, vowel noise (replace vowels), and synonym replacement using WordNet.
nodes.principle: Apply balanced text augmentations to training samples: random word swaps within a window, random punctuation insertion, vowel noise (replace vowels), and synonym replacement using WordNet.

nodes.title: Use DeBERTa-v3-large with stylometric features and two-stage fusion with LightGBM
nodes.action: Combine DeBERTa-v3-large transformer with handcrafted stylometric features (punctuation counts, stopword ratios, archaic/supernatural word counts, sentence length, etc.) and TF-IDF n-grams. Then extract pooled embeddings, concatenate with stylometric/TF-IDF features, and train a LightGBM classifier on the combined features.
nodes.principle: Combine DeBERTa-v3-large transformer with handcrafted stylometric features (punctuation counts, stopword ratios, archaic/supernatural word counts, sentence length, etc.) and TF-IDF n-grams. Then extract pooled embeddings, concatenate with stylometric/TF-IDF features, and train a LightGBM classifier on the combined features.

nodes.condition: When performing author identification on the Spooky Author Identification dataset and aiming for high accuracy with a large transformer model.

nodes.principle: Train two RoBERTa-base models with different random seeds, using label smoothing cross-entropy loss, AdamW optimizer, linear warmup scheduler, mixed precision, and early stopping. Average softmax outputs of the two models for final predictions.

Fit all transformations on the training fold only to prevent leakage.
nodes.principle: Engineer tabular features from margin/shape/texture groups: per-group statistics (mean, std, min, max, skew, kurtosis, quartiles, IQR, range, CV), ratio features, cross-group correlations, PCA per group (8 components) and difference PCA (5 components). nodes.title: Avoid passing dropout params directly to from_pretrained

nodes.title: Ensure model input dimensions match actual hidden size
nodes.action: When concatenating transformer embeddings with engineered features, verify the transformer's hidden size (e.g., ModernBERT-large has hidden_size=1024, not 768). The classifier input dimension must be hidden_size + feature_dim.

nodes.title: Avoid passing label_smoothing_factor to Hugging Face from_pretrained

nodes.title: Use progressive unfreezing with warm-up and differential learning rates to improve generalization
nodes.action: Train transformer models in phases: first freeze backbone and train only the head for a few epochs, then gradually unfreeze layers with lower learning rates (e.g., 1e-6 for backbone, 2e-5 for head) and use a warm-up phase to stabilize training.
nodes.principle: Train transformer models in phases: first freeze backbone and train only the head for a few epochs, then gradually unfreeze layers with lower learning rates (e.g., 1e-6 for backbone, 2e-5 for head) and use a warm-up phase to stabilize training.

nodes.condition: When fine-tuning a large transformer model to prevent overfitting and improve validation loss.

nodes.title: Use two-phase training with different stratified splits to improve performance
nodes.action: Train in two phases: Phase 1 on a stratified split (e.g., 17k train / 500 val) with warm-up and differential learning rates, then Phase 2 on a different stratified split to leverage more data and reduce overfitting.
nodes.principle: Train in two phases: Phase 1 on a stratified split (e.g., 17k train / 500 val) with warm-up and differential learning rates, then Phase 2 on a different stratified split to leverage more data and reduce overfitting.

nodes.condition: When aiming for best performance on a small dataset with a transformer model.

nodes.title: Use TextCNN with random embeddings and stylometric features for text classification
nodes.action: Tokenize text, build vocabulary, use trainable random embeddings (128-dim) with Xavier initialization, apply multi-filter CNN (kernel sizes 2,3,4,5, 128 filters each) with batch norm, ReLU, global max pooling, dropout (0.3), combine with 6 stylometric features via MLP branch, train with label smoothing cross-entropy, AdamW, and early stopping.
nodes.principle: Tokenize text, build vocabulary, use trainable random embeddings (128-dim) with Xavier initialization, apply multi-filter CNN (kernel sizes 2,3,4,5, 128 filters each) with batch norm, ReLU, global max pooling, dropout (0.3), combine with 6 stylometric features via MLP branch, train with label smoothing cross-entropy, AdamW, and early stopping.

nodes.condition: When transformer models are unavailable or too slow, and a CNN-based approach is preferred for text classification.

nodes.title: Avoid NaN predictions by simplifying attention mechanisms and using gradient clipping
nodes.action: When using complex attention pooling (e.g., weighted layer attention, multi-head attention) with mixed precision, simplify architecture or add gradient clipping (norm=1.0) and torch.nan_to_num to prevent NaN outputs.
nodes.principle: When using complex attention pooling (e.g., weighted layer attention, multi-head attention) with mixed precision, simplify architecture or add gradient clipping (norm=1.0) and torch.nan_to_num to prevent NaN outputs.

nodes.title: Use correct indexing for StratifiedKFold splits
nodes.action: When using StratifiedKFold, ensure that the indices from split() are applied to the full dataset, not to a subset that has already been reduced in size, to avoid IndexError.
nodes.principle: When using StratifiedKFold, ensure that the indices from split() are applied to the full dataset, not to a subset that has already been reduced in size, to avoid IndexError.

nodes.title: Clip probabilities after softmax to avoid NaN in log_loss
nodes.action: After computing softmax probabilities, clip them to a small epsilon range (e.g., 1e-7, 1-1e-7) to avoid log(0) and NaN values when computing log loss.
nodes.principle: After computing softmax probabilities, clip them to a small epsilon range (e.g., 1e-7, 1-1e-7) to avoid log(0) and NaN values when computing log loss.

nodes.condition: When computing cross-entropy or log loss on model outputs, especially with numerical instability.

nodes.title: Use ensemble of DeBERTa-v3-large, XGBoost, and Logistic Regression with weight optimization
nodes.action: Combine predictions from fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-large (with label smoothing, early stopping, mixed precision), XGBoost trained on DeBERTa embeddings plus handcrafted features, and Logistic Regression on TF-IDF n-gram features. Optimize ensemble weights via grid search on validation log loss.

nodes.title: Avoid using torch.no_grad() inside autocast() when gradients are needed
nodes.action: Do not wrap operations that require gradients with torch.no_grad() inside an autocast context. If MixUp or similar augmentation requires no_grad, compute it outside the training loop or on logits after forward pass.

nodes.condition: When implementing data augmentation that mixes samples (e.g., MixUp) and using mixed precision training.

nodes.title: Ensure classifier input dimension matches actual concatenated feature dimension
nodes.action: When building multi-encoder models, compute the total feature dimension by running a dummy forward pass or carefully summing encoder output dimensions. Verify that the classifier's first linear layer input size matches the actual concatenated feature size.
nodes.principle: When building multi-encoder models, compute the total feature dimension by running a dummy forward pass or carefully summing encoder output dimensions. Verify that the classifier's first linear layer input size matches the actual concatenated feature size.

nodes.condition: When building multi-encoder neural networks with concatenated features.

nodes.title: Avoid data augmentation that creates size mismatch between features and labels

nodes.principle: When applying back-translation or other augmentation, ensure that the number of augmented samples matches the number of labels. Duplicate labels accordingly or use a dataset that handles augmentation internally.

nodes.action: After each stage (feature extraction, model training, checkpoint saving, embedding extraction), print confirmation or check outputs. Ensure no silent failures before moving to next stage.

nodes.condition: When building complex multi-stage pipelines; early detection of bugs prevents wasted compute.

nodes.title: Use correct attribute name for ModernBERT embedding layer
nodes.action: Access ModernBERT's embedding layer via model.model.embeddings.tok_embeddings, not word_embeddings.
nodes.principle: Access ModernBERT's embedding layer via model.model.embeddings.tok_embeddings, not word_embeddings.

nodes.principle: Ensure all buffers in custom loss functions (e.g., AdaptiveFocalLoss.weights) are moved to the same device as the input tensors.

nodes.title: Use multi-layer pooling (weighted average of last hidden layers) for transformer embeddings
nodes.action: Instead of using only the CLS token, compute a weighted average of the last 3-4 hidden layers' token embeddings, then apply mean pooling over tokens to obtain a richer sentence representation.
nodes.principle: Instead of using only the CLS token, compute a weighted average of the last 3-4 hidden layers' token embeddings, then apply mean pooling over tokens to obtain a richer sentence representation.

nodes.title: Ensure model checkpoint architecture matches when saving and loading
nodes.action: When saving a model checkpoint, save only the state_dict and ensure the model architecture used for loading is exactly the same as during saving, including any custom heads or feature fusion layers.
nodes.principle: When saving a model checkpoint, save only the state_dict and ensure the model architecture used for loading is exactly the same as during saving, including any custom heads or feature fusion layers.

nodes.condition: When using custom model architectures or when loading a checkpoint into a different model instance.

nodes.title: Use 5-fold stratified cross-validation with OOF predictions for robust ensemble
nodes.action: Implement 5-fold stratified cross-validation to generate out-of-fold (OOF) predictions from each model, then train a meta-learner (e.g., logistic regression) on OOF probabilities to learn ensemble weights. This reduces overfitting and improves generalization compared to a single train/validation split.

nodes.condition: When building an ensemble of multiple models (e.g., transformer, XGBoost, logistic regression) for classification, and the dataset is small enough to allow multiple training runs.

nodes.title: Use ensemble of EfficientNet-B0 and ResNet-18 with spatial attention for improved robustness
nodes.action: Create an ensemble of EfficientNet-B0 and ResNet-18 models, each with a spatial attention module. Use 5-fold stratified cross-validation, RandAugment and CutMix augmentations, BCEWithLogitsLoss, AdamW optimizer with warmup and cosine annealing scheduler. Average predictions from all folds and both models for final submission.
nodes.principle: Create an ensemble of EfficientNet-B0 and ResNet-18 models, each with a spatial attention module. nodes.condition: When wanting to improve robustness and generalization beyond a single model for aerial cactus identification.

nodes.title: Set DataLoader num_workers=0 to avoid shared memory issues in containerized environments
nodes.action: Set num_workers=0 and pin_memory=False in DataLoader to avoid shared memory (shm) exhaustion, which causes bus errors and worker crashes. This trades off data loading speed for reliability.
nodes.principle: Set num_workers=0 and pin_memory=False in DataLoader to avoid shared memory (shm) exhaustion, which causes bus errors and worker crashes. This trades off data loading speed for reliability.

nodes.condition: When running in environments with limited shared memory (e.g., Docker containers, Kaggle notebooks) and experiencing DataLoader worker crashes due to shm issues.

nodes.title: Avoid computing train AUC when mixup augmentation produces continuous labels
nodes.action: Skip computing training AUC when mixup augmentation is applied, as the continuous labels (floats between 0 and 1) are incompatible with roc_auc_score which expects binary labels. Only compute validation AUC on non-mixed batches.
nodes.principle: Skip computing training AUC when mixup augmentation is applied, as the continuous labels (floats between 0 and 1) are incompatible with roc_auc_score which expects binary labels. Only compute validation AUC on non-mixed batches.

nodes.condition: When using mixup augmentation during training and attempting to compute training AUC with sklearn's roc_auc_score.

nodes.title: Use correct indexing for EfficientNet backbone blocks when unfreezing
nodes.action: When unfreezing specific blocks of an EfficientNet backbone from timm, iterate over the blocks list and unfreeze the last N blocks by index (e.g., for EfficientNet-B0, blocks are indexed 0-6, so unfreeze blocks[4:] for last 3 blocks). Use len(backbone.blocks) to determine the total number of blocks.
nodes.principle: When unfreezing specific blocks of an EfficientNet backbone from timm, iterate over the blocks list and unfreeze the last N blocks by index (e.g., for EfficientNet-B0, blocks are indexed 0-6, so unfreeze blocks[4:] for last 3 blocks). Use len(backbone.blocks) to determine the total number of blocks.

nodes.condition: When implementing partial fine-tuning of EfficientNet models from timm and needing to unfreeze specific blocks by index.

nodes.title: Add gradient clipping and input validation to prevent NaN predictions
nodes.action: Use gradient clipping (max_norm=1.0) and add input validation (e.g., clamp inputs to valid range) to prevent NaN values in model outputs. Also ensure mixed precision training uses consistent autocast context and proper GradScaler usage.

nodes.title: Use DINOv2 ViT-S/14 encoder with trainable backbone and differential learning rates
nodes.action: Use a pretrained DINOv2 ViT-S/14 as encoder, with a small warmup LR for the backbone (e.g., linear warmup from 0 to 5e-5) and a higher LR for the decoder (e.g., 1e-3), and unfreeze the last few encoder blocks after warmup.

nodes.title: Avoid using IPython magic commands (!pip) in standard Python scripts

nodes.title: Use per-group PCA and separate scaling for structured tabular features
nodes.action: Split features into groups (e.g., margin, shape, texture), apply StandardScaler and PCA (retaining 95% variance) independently per group to preserve group-specific structure and reduce dimensionality without mixing information.
